## Source: amazon-inspector (09b780cc0f3d918e82d8f9999cba10b7188b785d2c42a1a7bab2bc2f693e21c2)
The brummatts 0.1.0 PyPI package shows no code paths performing credential access, outbound network I/O to attacker-controlled destinations, install-time fetch-and-execute, silent relay of caller data, backdoor channels, or self-propagation. No lifecycle hooks or import-time side effects of concern were identified across the 13 files examined.

## Source: kam193 (605ea05e6c6344e7ddfb713297d7689ee050288b74ecbf0821039603dc3cdd45)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
